query_text: Create a news feed reader app for my phone where I can scroll through the latest stories from topics I actually care about, like tech and food, and each story shows the headline plus a little thumbnail so I can quickly decide what to tap into.

A mobile news feed app where the home screen shows a nice list of today's top stories grouped by topic, and I can tap any story to read the full thing — the kind of app I can open on my phone first thing in the morning to catch up quickly.

Create a daily news feed app for my phone that pulls in stories from different categories like sports, business, and lifestyle, shows them in a clean list with a short preview under each headline, and lets me tap to read the full article.

Need a mobile news reader app that lets me pick a few topics I like and then shows me a personalized feed of articles every day, with each story showing the source name and how long ago it was posted so I can tell what's fresh.

Create a reading app for my phone that saves exactly where I left off in any article and shows a thin progress bar at the top of the reading screen so I always know how far through a piece I am — it should feel calm and minimal, like a good book.

Make a mobile article reader app that lets me gift any story to a friend with a single tap — the gifting flow should feel warm and personal, like wrapping something up for someone, with a little note field so I can add a message before I send it.

Create a mobile article reader app that also has a clean print-ready version of every story — when I tap the print option the layout strips away everything extra and just shows the text in a nice typographic format that looks great on paper.

A mobile reading app where the reading screen lets me slide a little control to make the lines of text more spread out or closer together depending on my mood — the whole thing should feel airy and pleasant to read on my phone, like a beautifully typeset magazine.

Need a mobile article reader app that shows a table of contents at the start of every long piece so I can jump straight to the part I want to read, with each section label clearly listed and one tap taking me right there.

Build a subscriber growth tracker app for my phone where I can see how my follower count is going up over time, check daily and weekly numbers in a simple chart, and get a summary of which posts brought in the most new subscribers.

Need a mobile app that lets me tune what kinds of news and articles get recommended to me — I want to be able to say I like more of this topic and less of that one, and have the app actually remember and adjust what shows up in my feed going forward.

A do-not-disturb scheduler for a mobile news alert app where I can set specific quiet hours — like nights and weekends — so news notifications pause during those times and I only get pinged when it matters during my day.

Need a mobile app that keeps an archive of all the newsletters and channels I've subscribed to, organized by date, so I can go back and find old issues I missed or want to re-read without losing them.

Build a podcast subscription manager app for my phone where I can see all the shows I follow in one place, check which episodes are new, and mark episodes as listened so I always know where I left off with each show.

Need a mobile news search app that lets me switch between searching just headlines and searching the full text of articles, because sometimes I only remember a word from inside the story and scanning just titles never finds it for me.

Need a mobile news search app that lets me filter results to show only stories with photos or only stories with videos, because I hate scrolling through walls of text when I just want to find a news clip or a photo story I saw earlier.

A news filter app for my phone where I can turn on a setting that keeps sponsored and promoted articles out of my search results, so when I look something up I only see actual news stories and editorial content.

A news reader app for my phone where I can flip a switch to show or hide articles that are behind a paywall in the search results, so I can choose to only see free stories when I'm browsing and not click on something I can't read.

Make a news archive lookup app for my phone that lets me pick a specific date or date range and see all the stories published then, so I can actually go back and find old coverage of something without digging through endless scroll.

Create a product Q&A app for my phone where shoppers can ask questions about a product and sellers can reply directly in a thread under each question, so buyers can see the full back-and-forth conversation and get the answers they need before buying.

Make a mobile product showcase app where each product page has a short demo video right there in the listing, so shoppers can watch it play on their phone without leaving the page — I want the video to show the product actually being used.

Build a shopping cart app for my phone that handles split delivery, meaning if I have items going to different addresses like home and office I can split them into separate shipments at checkout and see the delivery details for each one.

Make a mobile checkout app that pulls up my saved addresses when I'm ready to pay so I can just tap the one I want instead of typing it out every single time — I want to be able to add a new address too if I'm sending somewhere new.

Build a return request app for my phone that walks me through the whole return process step by step — I pick the item, say why I'm returning it, and at the end it shows me a shipping label I can print or share with the post office to send it back.

Refund tracker app for my phone that shows exactly where my refund is at right now and a simple timeline of what's already happened and what's coming next, so I can stop wondering when the money is actually hitting my account.
